title: Inland American Communities Enters Into Student Housing Development Partnership
summary: Inland American Communities (IAC), a wholly owned subsidiary of Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. (Inland American), announced today that it has entered into a partnership with an Oregon-based development company and investors on a student housing development, University House Arena District, at the University of Oregon in Eugene, Ore. The planned University House Arena District, at the University of Oregon in Eugene, Ore. (Photo: Business Wire) Located within one quarter mile from the University of Oregons campus, the property is projected to open in fall 2013 and will add 244 beds to IACs existing student housing portfolio, which currently includes over 5,000 beds. The new partnership structure also provides IAC with a significant equity stake, a preferred equity return and an exclusive purchase option upon stabilization. The University House Arena District asset aligns with our strategy to double the size of our student housing portfolio
